@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+name: ZEUS repository intelligence
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - '.zeus/repository-graph.json'
+      - '.zeus/repository-graph-declarations.json'
+      - 'scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.test.mjs'
+      - '.github/workflows/zeus-repository-intelligence.yml'
+      - 'packages/**'
+      - 'apps/web/**'
+      - 'contracts/**'
+      - 'rust/arq-core/**'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: zeus-repository-intelligence-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  graph-regression:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - name: Prove literal pull-request head checkout
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+          expected="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
+          printf 'actual=%s\nexpected=%s\n' "$actual" "$expected"
+          test "$actual" = "$expected"
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+          cache: pnpm
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Check repository intelligence syntax
+        run: node --check scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs
+
+      - name: Run repository intelligence regressions
+        run: node --test scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.test.mjs
+
+      - name: Build fresh repository graph
+        run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json build
+
+      - name: Require fresh repository graph
+        run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json status
+
+      - name: Preflight canonical semantic model
+        run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json preflight packages/bim-core
+
+      - name: Inspect pull-request diff impact
+        run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json diff-impact --base "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"
+
+      - name: Verify ZEUS drift guard itself
+        run: node scripts/zeus-drift-guard-test.mjs
+
+      - name: Verify ZEUS drift state
+        run: pnpm zeus:drift
+
+      - name: Validate ZEUS operating system
+        run: pnpm zeus:validate
+
+      - name: Verify editor dependency boundaries
+        run: pnpm check:editor-dependency-boundaries

@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+{
+  "protocol": "zeus-repository-intelligence/v1",
+  "schema_version": 1,
+  "extractor_version": "1.0.0",
+  "hard_gate_provenance": ["deterministic", "declared"],
+  "declarations": [".zeus/repository-graph-declarations.json"],
+  "exclude_prefixes": [
+    ".git/",
+    ".turbo/",
+    "node_modules/",
+    "coverage/",
+    "dist/",
+    "build/",
+    "out/",
+    "target/"
+  ],
+  "source_extensions": [
+    ".js",
+    ".jsx",
+    ".mjs",
+    ".cjs",
+    ".ts",
+    ".tsx",
+    ".json",
+    ".py",
+    ".rs",
+    ".toml",
+    ".md",
+    ".yml",
+    ".yaml"
+  ],
+  "budgets": {
+    "max_nodes": 240,
+    "max_depth": 4,
+    "max_context_chars": 28000
+  },
+  "protected_domains": [
+    "semantic_model",
+    "operations",
+    "ai_operations",
+    "persistence",
+    "geometry_units",
+    "contract"
+  ],
+  "verification_frontiers": {
+    "harness": ["node scripts/zeus-drift-guard-test.mjs", "pnpm zeus:drift", "pnpm zeus:validate"],
+    "renderer_ui": ["pnpm lint", "pnpm test", "pnpm build"],
+    "public_adapter": ["pnpm lint", "pnpm test", "pnpm build"],
+    "protected": ["pnpm zeus:validate", "pnpm lint", "pnpm typecheck", "pnpm test", "pnpm build"]
+  }
+}
